title: TableTune: Measured, Self-Correcting Draft-Length Tables for Dynamic Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.38968v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model (LLM) serving only while the GPU has spare compute, so the best draft length, the number of tokens a small drafter guesses per step, shrinks as the batch grows. vLLM lets operators set the draft length for each batch size with a hand-written table, but nothing measures or corrects that table. We present TableTune. Its tuner times the decoding step for every batch size and draft length on vLLM's own serving path and computes, in minutes, the table that maximizes throughput. Its controller, a vLLM plugin, tracks how many guesses are accepted in live traffic and rebuilds the table while serving. We measure TableTune only against other ways to speculate. On an H100, the tuned table delivers at least 94% of the throughput of the best fixed draft length at every load in four of five drafter settings (88% in the fifth) without the operator having to know which length that is. Against reimple

translated_title: TableTune：面向动态投机解码的实测自校正草稿长度表
translated_abstract: 投机解码只有在大语言模型（LLM）服务的GPU尚有空闲算力时才能带来加速，因此最优草稿长度（即小型起草模型每步猜测的token数量）会随批次规模增大而缩短。vLLM允许运维人员通过一张手工编写的表格为每个批次大小设置草稿长度，但没有任何机制来测量或修正这张表格。我们提出了TableTune。其调优器在vLLM自身的服务路径上，为每个批次大小与草稿长度的组合测量解码步骤的耗时，并在几分钟内计算出使吞吐量最大化的表格。其控制器是一个vLLM插件，可在实际流量中追踪猜测被接受的比率，并在服务运行的同时重建表格。我们仅将TableTune与其他投机方式进行了对比测量。在H100上，经调优的表格在五种起草设置中的四种（第五种为88%）内，于所有负载下均能达到最佳固定草稿长度吞吐量的至少94%，而运维人员无需事先知道该最佳长度是多少。
tldr: TableTune通过在vLLM真实服务路径上实测各批次大小与草稿长度组合的解码耗时来自动生成最优草稿长度表，并借助运行时接受率反馈在服务过程中持续自校正，在H100上无需人工调参即可达到最佳固定草稿长度吞吐量的94%以上。
en_tdlr: TableTune automatically builds and continuously self-corrects draft-length tables for speculative decoding by measuring decode-step latencies across batch sizes on vLLM's serving path and adapting to live acceptance rates, achieving at least 94% of the best fixed draft length's throughput on H100 without operator tuning.
